text:
maya: heads-up — we need a default behavior for automatic model-variant fallback when the primary is saturated. cc @raj @ellen

raj: are we talking GPU-level capacity (queue/slots) or request-rate/QPS? need precise signal to trigger on.

elllen: capacity-based. prefer to spill to a compatible quantized variant in the same region before doing cross-region or tier demotion. Also need console toggles + telemetry.

sam: what is "compatible" exactly? same model family + same tokenizer + supports same function-calling schema?

maya: proposal sketch: router monitors primary health. trigger if either: queue_depth_pct > 80% for 30s OR available_slots == 0 for 5s OR simulated_latency_p90 > p90_baseline * 1.5 for 60s. fallback order: 1) same-region compatible variant (quantized/cheaper) 2) same-region lower-tier variant 3) cross-region compatible variant. Attach header: `X-Redwood-Fallback: variant=<id>;reason=capacity`.

raj: :+1: add per-tenant controls: opt-out flag + `max_fallback_percent` so we don't silently change UX for critical tenants.

elllen: console UX: add a per-tenant switch "Enable auto-variant fallback on saturation" + live panel showing spillover rate, last fallback reason, and current fallback chain.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag will be `auto_variant_fallback`. initial rollout to internal + beta orgs.

sam: API question — do we return 429 when primary saturated? if we return 200 with fallback, we must expose model origin in response metadata so callers can audit.

maya: agree. response headers: `X-Redwood-Model-Origin` (primary|fallback) and `X-Redwood-Fallback-Chain` (comma list). Also include `x-redwood-fallback-sampled=true` for canary sampling.

raj: telemetry we need: `redwood.fallback.attempts`, `redwood.fallback.successes`, `redwood.fallback.rejected_by_policy`, `redwood.fallback.latency_delta_ms` and a gauge `redwood.model.queue_depth_pct` per model-instance. Tag by tenant, region, primary_variant, fallback_variant.

elllen: dashboard panels: - Fallback rate (tenant filter) - Avg latency delta during fallback - Top tenants by fallback volume - Recent fallback reasons stream. Also add alert: fallback_rate > 5% for 10m for enterprise tenants.

sam: edge cases: function-calling / tool support. Router must check capability matrix before choosing a fallback — if fallback doesn't support tool schema, fail open only if tenant allows.

maya: security note: logs should include tenant id, variant ids and region, but redact request payloads. KMS not impacted.

raj: impl notes: router will consult compatibility table cached in memory (updated by model-catalog service). Will add sampling flag so we can start at 10% of eligible requests, ramp to 100% after safe checks.

sam: tests: add e2e chaos test simulating primary eviction and verifying fallback headers + metrics + console signals. Also unit tests for compatibility lookup.

elllen: ops comms: inform SRE & CS before wide rollout. Include runbook: how to flip feature flag off, how to interpret the console panels.

ops-bot: incident-bot: rollback plan in place: feature-flag toggle `auto_variant_fallback` can be turned off globally. Documented in runbook.

maya: timeline: PR for router + feature-flag by Thu, console mockups and metrics names by Fri, canary to beta orgs next Wed. I'll draft RFC and OWNERS.

sam: I'll start the compatibility matrix (model_family -> supported_features + tokenizer + tool_capabilities).

raj: I'll own router changes and the canary sampling. will add logging for every fallback decision (queued asynchronously).

elllen: note — add an opt-in annotation in account settings so devs are notified when their requests were served by fallback (email / console notification).

maya: any blockers?

sam: need final list of metric names and tenant opt-out API shape.

raj: I'll put a small API draft in the ticket: `POST /v1/tenants/{id}/fallbacks` body `{ "enabled": bool, "max_fallback_percent": int }`.

elllen: perfect. thanks y'all.

maya: thanks — filing the RFC now and will tag owners. :tada:
